summary: All-feature Causal R3 run avoided near-zero collapse but produced nearly time-invariant outputs. Scalar loss decreased strongly, but fixed-grid PDE diagnostics improved only early then worsened: fixed_pde bottomed around step 450 and res_p95 around step 500 before rising by step 2000. Timestep loss was effectively inactive because lambda_timestep=1e-4 and Wang weighting reduced w_timestep to ~7.9e-3, making the final timestep contribution ~7.7e-7. IC weight also fell to ~2e-3. BC flux was clamped for 100% of boundary evaluations throughout, so BC diagnostics remain numerically suspect.
interpretation: Most likely causes are gated PDE loss from --causal-r3-weight-pde-loss, weak timestep anchoring, fixed R3 time slabs with only x resampling, and Wang downweighting of IC/timestep anchors. Training longer alone is unlikely to fix this unless temporal constraints are made meaningful.
next_action: Run ablation removing --causal-r3-weight-pde-loss while keeping Causal R3 scoring; increase lambda_timestep to 1e-2 and timestep_n_pairs to 8; compare output temporal variance and fixed-grid diagnostics.
